verdict: Leads are coming in, but rising cost per lead needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 127 leads from Meta at an average cost of $6.19 per lead — a solid baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days, spend increased 139.7% while leads grew only 16%, pushing cost per lead up 106.64%; the primary campaign is scaling faster than conversion efficiency can support. We're pulling back on that campaign's budget and tightening its audience targeting this week to bring cost per lead back in line. Separately, website conversion tracking is being repaired, so web-reported conversions currently under-report actual activity — lead counts above come directly from Meta and are reliable. Next period you should expect steadier cost per lead as the campaign adjustments take hold.
